title: Verify: loadWorld strict loading unit tests
summary: Unit tests for loader.ts loadWorld error and success paths using temp directories.
description: Context: loadWorld now checks fields and scene ids. Desired behavior: tests assert each error and the array result using files in an os temp dir only. Expected result: tests/loader.test.ts passes.
acceptance_criteria: Missing id in world.yaml makes loadWorld throw /id/
Scene id mismatch makes loadWorld throw /expected s/
Valid files give an array scenes with scenes[0].id === 's'
technical_constraints: Use fs.mkdtempSync under os.tmpdir(); no network or real content dir

steps.action: Create the file importing describe, it, expect from vitest, fs, os, path and loadWorld from '../src/content/loader'; add helper makeWorldDir(files: Record<string,string>) that mkdtemps a dir and writes each relative path with mkdirSync recursive.
steps.expected: Typecheck passes with the new test file and helper compiling.

steps.symbol: new: describe loadWorld; it 'throws when id is missing'
steps.action: Write world.yaml without the id line (title W, startScene s, scenes [s], characters [], flags []) plus a valid scenes/s.yaml, and expect(() => loadWorld(dir)).toThrow(/id/).
steps.command: npx vitest run tests/loader.test.ts -t "id is missing"

steps.symbol: it 'throws naming s2.yaml and on scene id mismatch'; it 'returns scenes array'
steps.action: Add three tests: world listing s and s2 with only s.yaml expects toThrow(/s2\.yaml/); s.yaml declaring `id: other` expects toThrow(/expected s/); a valid world expects Array.isArray(loaded.scenes) and loaded.scenes[0].id toBe 's'.
